entries.title: Merging a change with a step for you after no longer pauses the window
entries.body: When a merged change leaves you a step to take afterwards, such as installing it on another computer, Infinitary now finds that step's task directly instead of reading every task you have. On a long history the window no longer stops responding for a moment after the merge click.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the merge finishes the same way, without the pause.
